text: The purpose of this staff report is to seek City Council approval of the 19 Duncan Street – Public Art Plan. The Plan, which is included as Attachment 1 of this report, outlines the method by which the owner will commission public art on a publicly-accessible privately-owned area of the development site. This Public Art Plan provides a framework and description of the commissioning of public art including the development overview; historic context; architectural context; project team; public art budget; public art location; public art objectives; public art sites and opportunities; selection process and rationale; examples of selected artist work; jury composition; schedule and developer background and public art experience. The attached plan meets the objectives of the City Planning's Percent for Public Art Guidelines and is supported by the Toronto Public Art Commission.

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the 19 Duncan Street - Public Art Plan in Attachment 1 to the report (March 9, 2018) from the Director, Urban Design.
